channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Awami League condemns attacks on media offices, flags crisis in Bangladesh
item.description: Bangladesh’s Awami League party strongly condemned a series of nationwide attacks targeting media offices, cultural institutions, and diplomatic missions, describing them as a “planned terrorist attack.”

item.title: Dense fog grips Delhi-NCR, AQI remains in ‘very poor’ category
item.description: Delhi-NCR woke up to a thick blanket of fog on Saturday, with the India Meteorological Department issuing an orange alert for dense fog conditions expected to persist through the day.

item.title: DMK alliance to hold statewide protest on Dec 24 against Centre’s rural job scheme overhaul
item.description: The protest aims to mobilise beneficiaries of the existing 100-day rural employment scheme along with district secretaries, MLAs, local body representatives, and cadre from the alliance parties.

item.title: Ed Sheeran spills secrets of his disciplined approach to performing Los
item.description: Grammy-winner Ed Sheeran said he lived an unhealthy lifestyle during his younger years, but is now making a conscious effort to live more healthily and ensure that he's ready for the challenge of performing live.

item.title: ‘No one respects women more’: JD-U defends CM Nitish Kumar amid hijab row
item.description: Amid the controversy triggered by a viral video allegedly showing Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar removing a woman's hijab during a public event, Janata Dal-U MP Rampreet Mandal on Saturday came out in his defence, asserting that no leader in the country respects women more than him.

item.title: Top players gear up for Thailand Tennis Masters in February
item.description: The Lawn Tennis Association of Thailand (LTAT) has announced that the Thailand Tennis Masters 2026 will be held in February 2026 at the National Tennis Development Center in Muang Thong Thani, Nonthaburi.

item.title: Varun Dhawan on undergoing gruelling schedule & shooting at real locations for ‘Border 2’
item.description: Actor Varun Dhawan will be seen in a completely fresh avatar in his next, "Border 2". However, in order to do justice to playing the role inspired by the real-life war hero, Colonel Hoshiar Singh Dahiya, he had to undergo some intense training that included strength training, endurance work, and mobility.

item.title: SpiceJet passenger alleges assault by Air India Express pilot at Delhi airport
item.description: A SpiceJet passenger has accused an Air India Express pilot of assaulting him following a dispute over allegedly cutting the boarding queue at Indira Gandhi International Airport’s Terminal 1 in an incident that has triggered widespread attention on social media.

item.title: ‘PM Modi to energise workers, address Bengal and Nation,’ says Union Minister Sukanta Majumdar
item.description: Union Minister of State Sukanta Majumdar has said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to Ranaghat on Saturday will see him addressing not only the people of Bengal but the entire nation.

item.title: Common air pollutants may impair mood, memory in adolescents: Study
item.description: Exposure to air pollution may have serious implications for a child's developing brain and cause damage to language development, memory, and mood regulation, according to a study.
